tail:
Batch 51 is fully authored. The main theorem now uses the \(N=2^*\) mass insertion, with \(\widetilde m=i m_E+r^{-1}\) at S4, matching Pestun’s mass convention and shifted tangent weights ([Pestun, §§4.3 and 5](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0712.2824)). The U(2), one-instanton example derives the two fixed-point terms and their sum. A local rank-one lemma supports the U(1) example without extending the shared ADHM definition beyond its \(N\ge2\) domain.

The A/B pages are frontmatter-only. Batch evidence and notes are in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/research/advanced-qft-supersymmetry-build-2026-10-23-batch-51.notes.md), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/research/advanced-qft-supersymmetry-build-2026-10-23-batch-51.proof-contracts.json), [coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/research/advanced-qft-supersymmetry-build-2026-10-23-batch-51.coverage.json), and [cross-batch dependency records](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/research/advanced-qft-supersymmetry-build-2026-10-23-batch-51.cross-batch-dependencies.json).

Scoped checks passed: precheck, proof layout, strict proof contracts, content policy, rendering, dependency and forward-reference checks, source-fetch verification, and coverage checklist. Five sources were fetch-verified; the harvest records 9 included, 8 inline, and 4 out-of-scope results.

The rank-one lemma and U(1) example are recorded `ready`. The series definition, main theorem, and U(2) example are `escalated`: the ADHM definition’s stored readiness hash is stale, the ADHM theorem is owner-escalated, and the S4 postulate has no current readiness record. The current Borel–Moore suppliers are ready and their scoped interfaces are verified. The run-wide statement-first check is blocked by the empty batch-49 S3 inventory; dependency-level checking reports 17 unrelated run errors, with none in batch 51. Exact blockers and next actions are in the notes.
